strip.california: California needs a person to add required wording to a first message.

strip.no_channel: They have no channel we can use: none agreed to, or it bounced.
strip.not_checked: The second check couldn't run, so a person looks.

strip.money: No draft. Money questions go to a person.

strip.instructions: No draft. It tells the AI what to write, so a person answers.
strip.money_read: No draft. The AI check read this as about money, so a person answers.
